sn47.30:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Mānadinno gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3--6.
sn47.30:1.3: Atha kho Mānadinno gahapati aññataram purisam āmantesi ||
sn47.30:1.6: Evarūpāya cāham bhante dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.30:1.9: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 8.
sn47.30:1.10: Yānicimāni bhante Bhagavatā pañcorambhāgiyani saṃyojanāni desitāni || nāham bhante yaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmīti || || 9.
sn47.30:1.11: Lābhā te gahapati || suladdhan te gahapati ||
sn47.30:2.4: Mānadinnena te dasā ti || || Satipaṭṭhāna-saṃyuttassa Sīlaṭṭhitivaggo tatiyo || || 1--2. Sāvatthi nidānam || || 3.
